done_summary: Implemented context isolation per request during async SSR and fixed ErrorBoundary to render fallback only once. Context values are now held in a per-render store carried across await boundaries with AsyncLocalStorage when available; otherwise, they fall back to the context default value after await. ErrorBoundary now sets a caught flag on the first catch to ensure the fallback renders and reports exactly once. The changes ensure that context does not leak across concurrent requests and that ErrorBoundary behaves correctly when multiple children reject.
